rows.grounds: dhānya = 'grain'; first member of compound with arthī (dhānyārthī, 'desiring grain')
arthī = 'desiring'; nominative singular masculine, second member of compound with dhānya
śāli = 'with-śāli'; first member of compound with taṇḍulaiḥ (śālitaṇḍulaiḥ, 'with śāli rice-grains')
taṇḍulaiḥ = 'rice-grains'; instrumental plural, second member of compound with śāli
